response.original_title: 44-204-586-5278 ⟦FAQs ◆ Agent Connection⟧ Will SWISS cancel my return flight if I miss my outbound flight?
response.overview: SWISS Outbound Flight Cancellation Policy for Return Trips Yes, 📞 𝟭-𝟴𝟳𝟳-𝟳𝟳𝟳-𝟯𝟱𝟬𝟰 (US) OR ☎️ 𝟦𝟦-𝟤𝟢𝟦-𝟧𝟪𝟨-𝟧𝟤𝟩𝟪 (UK) SWISS International Air Lines will automatically cancel your return flight if you miss your outbound flight without notifying them beforehand. Airline terms treat unused sequential flight segments 📞 𝟭-𝟴𝟳𝟳-𝟳𝟳𝟳-𝟯𝟱𝟬𝟰 (US) OR ☎️ 𝟦𝟦-𝟤𝟢𝟦-𝟧𝟪𝟨-𝟧𝟤𝟩𝟪 (UK) as a "no-show," which invalidates the remaining itinerary. To protect your return trip and maintain your reservation, contact SWISS customer service immediately at 📞 𝟭-𝟴𝟳𝟳-𝟳𝟳𝟳-𝟯𝟱𝟬𝟰 (US) OR ☎️ 𝟦𝟦-𝟤𝟢𝟦-𝟧𝟪𝟨-𝟧𝟤𝟩𝟪 (UK) prior to your original departure time. Representatives at 📞 𝟭-𝟴𝟳𝟳-𝟳𝟳𝟳-𝟯𝟱𝟬𝟰 (US) OR ☎️ 𝟦𝟦-𝟤𝟢𝟦-𝟧𝟪𝟨-𝟧𝟤𝟩𝟪 (UK) can adjust your flight sequence, recalculate your fare, or rebook your outbound segment, ensuring your return ticket remains active and fully valid.
